speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your work with livestock and rice farming, I need to ask if you have noticed any hair loss or scaling on your scalp, as this combination of symptoms could suggest a specific parasitic infection.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Those symptoms—specifically the eyebrow thinning, eyelash loss, and hypopigmented macules on the elbows—along with the palm tingling are highly suggestive of cutaneous leishmaniasis or, more likely given the distribution and neuropathy, Hansen's disease (Leprosy). DIAGNOSIS READY: Hansen's disease (Leprosy)
